---
title: "Governance"
---

The Centre operates under a constitution approved by the Faculty and a Research
Charter that governs research independence, data governance, and our
relationships with funders and data partners. Both are published here in full.

```{r}
#| include: false
source("../R/chf.R")
board <- yaml::read_yaml("_board.yml")
docs  <- yaml::read_yaml("_documents.yml")
```

## Board

The Board oversees the Centre's work and holds the Director to account for it.

```{r}
#| output: asis
chf_board_table(board)
chf_stamp("_board.yml", "Board as at")
```

## Documents

```{r}
#| output: asis
chf_doc_list(docs)
chf_stamp("_documents.yml", "Register last updated")
```
